title: Acquirer: Southern Cross Broadcasting (Australia) Ltd; Target: Data and Commerce Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Acquisition of interest in Data and Commerce Ltd (DCL) by Southern Cross Broadcasting (Australia) Ltd (SCB)
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market was considered to be the market for the supply of commercial broadcast radio advertising services in Melbourne.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission considered that the acquisition did not, of itself, appear to have the effect of: increasing the likelihood of co-ordinated conduct between SCB and DCL; foreclosing sales opportunities by third parties to DCL; or of providing SCB access to DCL's commercially sensitive information.  Further, the Commission considered that the acquisition did not appear to limit DCL's ability, or provide a disincentive, to become a better rival in its own right. On this basis, the Commission decided to not oppose the acquisition.
